title: Data Analysis and Visualization with Python

content.text: This module transitions from writing programs (Week 4) to analyzing real datasets and generating insights.
Objective: Access and manipulate datasets, perform statistical analysis, visualize patterns/trends, and build dashboards.

A Python library used to create graphs and plots.

content.code:
try:
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
    speeds = [40, 50, 60, 70]
    plt.plot(speeds)
    plt.title("Traffic Speed Trend")
    plt.show()
except Exception as e:
    print("Error:", e)

content.text: Definition: EDA is the process of understanding data before applying models.
Goal: Identify trends, detect anomalies, prepare data for ML.
Definition: Dashboards are interactive visual interfaces that display data insights.
End-to-End Process: Load data (Pandas) → Clean data → Analyze (Stats, filtering) → Visualize (Matplotlib) → Present (Dashboard).

content.code:
try:
    import pandas as pd
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
    df = pd.DataFrame({"Speed": [30, 45, 60, 80]})
    print(df.describe())
    plt.hist(df["Speed"])
    plt.title("Speed Distribution")
    plt.show()
except Exception as e:
    print("Error:", e)
